Vandermonde independence gives positive retained bounds. The extracted standalone checker actually passed; only its exact rational finite certificate is needed for the small cases, while finite floating checks are corroborative.

value.rationale: The exact sharp adversarial three-erasure stability of the canonical four-character cyclic frame, including unique mask geometry and all orders N>=7, is a naturally motivated spectral invariant for robust Fourier measurements. The fourth-row oscillatory kernel and exceptional finite orders make this nontrivial and not a cosmetic change to two- or three-row formulas.
